description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DittoAcknowledgementLabelExternalUseForbiddenException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when an internal acknowledgement label is used externally, indicating a forbidden operation. It includes constructors, a static factory method for JSON deserialization, and a builder class for creating instances.
